scope.description: Sri Lanka: source-country statistical territory, restricted to the existing reviewed entity/year territorial compatibility. Whole-island Ceylon after1815 coastal/interior unification; NationalArchives1815Convention together with Parliament council chronology supports distinct government frameworks for the same island statistical scope. Modern provider labelSriLanka is citation geography only, never historical state name. No military/harbour exclusions are imported from unrelated1911census; this series is whole-population retrospective/provider annual estimate. Approve only complete requested years within actual existing framework bounds.
